sourceFacts.claim: `product.template` is described as `Product`, while `product.product` is described as `Product Variant` and delegates template fields through `product_tmpl_id`.
The Item DocType is described as a Product or a Service that is bought, sold or kept in stock and is identified by required unique Item Code.
llx_product stores ref, label, prices, tosell, tobuy, tobatch and fk_product_type; fk_product_type 0 is regular product and 1 is service.
Tryton defines product.template and product.product; the latter is a Variant of the Product Template.
Catalog Manager manages Product, Catalog, and Category information; Product can be physical or digital.

`product.template.product_variant_ids` is a One2many to `product.product`; each variant requires a cascading `product_tmpl_id`, and `product_template_attribute_value_ids` records its Attribute Values.
Item links Variant Of to another Item with has_variants enabled, links Item Group to a non-group Item Group, and links Default Unit of Measure to UOM.
llx_product carries fk_default_warehouse, fk_default_bom, fk_default_workstation, fk_unit and fk_project references.
product.template relates to product.product through Variants; product.product relates back through Product Template.
ProductAssoc relates a Main Product and an Assoc Product with a productAssocTypeId and effective fromDate/thruDate.
`ProductTemplate` overrides `create` and `write`; creation calls `_create_variant_ids`, while writes affecting attribute lines or reactivation can also call `_create_variant_ids`.
Item implements autoname, after_insert, validate, on_update, on_trash, before_rename, and after_rename operations.
Product::create creates a product/service and returns its id on success or a negative value on failure.
product.uom.compute_qty converts a quantity from one UoM to another.
The product service boundary defines createProduct and updateProduct operations.
`ProductTemplate.create(vals_list)` consumes value dictionaries, creates templates, creates variants unless `create_product_product` is false in context, and returns `templates`.
Item autoname strips Item Code and assigns it to both item_code and the document name; naming-series mode can first derive that Item Code.
Products::post validates request_data, checks fields, calls Product::create and returns the Product id.
Product Template inputs include required Name, Type and Default UoM; Product rec_name is derived from Code and Name.
createProduct takes productTypeId and internalName as required inputs and productId as optional INOUT primary key.

createProduct exposes the Product primary key as INOUT, providing the created Product identifier as observable output.
